description: This file defines a React-like component using the Qwik framework that displays a leaderboard by fetching data on visibility, managing loading/error states, and rendering a table.

methods.name: component$
methods.description: Creates a Qwik component that manages UI state and effects.

methods.name: useStore
methods.description: Initializes reactive state for the component.

methods.name: useVisibleTask$
methods.description: Defines a side effect that runs when the component becomes visible, used here to fetch leaderboard data.
